name: Crown Towers Melbourne
positioning: Luxury hotel on the Yarra River in Melbourne's Southbank precinct, attached to the city's first casino and the Crown entertainment complex
best_for: Travelers who want a Southbank base a short walk from Flinders Street Station
Guests who want Villas with private butler service
Travelers who enjoy having a casino, bars and fine dining on site

facts.text: Crown Towers Melbourne is located on the Yarra River.
The hotel is in the Southbank precinct, alongside the Yarra River.
The hotel is less than a five-minute walk from Flinders Street Station.
The Villas have Melbourne views and elegant living and dining spaces.
The hotel's design reflects its Melbourne location.
Conde Nast Traveler notes ample use of glass and crystal at the hotel.
The Crown entertainment complex attached to the hotel has bars, cinemas and nightclubs.
Fine dining choices include Nobu and Rockpool.

highlights.text: The Villas come with private butler service.
Guest rooms and suites offer city views and an abundance of space.
Melbourne's first casino is attached to Crown Towers.
Conde Nast Traveler notes that spa and fitness facilities are well represented.

considerations.text: The hotel is attached to a casino and sits in the bustling Southbank precinct.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
